skill.name: amazon-multi-domain-product-price-and-detail-scraper
skill.description: Request public Amazon product data through an Apify Actor using URLs, ASINs, or discovery queries across 21 supported marketplaces.
skill.summary: Configure Amazon product lookups and filtered discovery, then retrieve JSON rows through Apify.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 79 static findings are false positives: formatting backticks, fixed example paths, documented configuration reads, and expected Apify requests. No evidence found of prompt injection, shell injection, or unauthorized credential transfer in the reviewed files. The remote Actor implementation was not included, so its behavior and data handling remain outside this audit.

content.user_title: Collect Amazon Product Data Across Marketplaces
content.value_statement: Comparing public Amazon listings across countries requires consistent inputs and repeatable data collection. This skill configures Apify requests and retrieves product dataset rows for analysis.
actual_capabilities: Submit product URLs, ASINs, keyword searches, search URLs, or bestseller URLs to the documented Apify Actor.
Configure 21 marketplace options, additional domains, language, display currency, and delivery postal codes through the supplied input schema.
Set discovery price, rating, condition, deal, stock, and sort options, plus item and page limits.
Request product-detail enrichment and optional variant or public review snippets through documented Actor input switches.
Run synchronous requests with the Node.js runner and follow documented asynchronous curl commands for larger jobs.
Retrieve JSON rows with declared fields including title, ASIN, price, rating, review count, stock, brand, URL, and record type.
limitations: Requires an Apify account, APIFY_TOKEN, internet access, and applicable usage charges; the bundled runner requires Node.js 18 or later.
The remote Actor implementation is not bundled or verified here; seller, variant, and specification outputs are not enumerated in the declared output schema.
Private data and full review pagination are unsupported; some filters are best effort, and converted display currency may differ from local pricing.
The synchronous endpoint waits up to 300 seconds; maxItems limits discovery only, and built-in scheduling, alerts, or CSV conversion are not provided.

use_cases.title: Compare Regional Listings
use_cases.description: Collect public listings for selected ASINs across marketplaces and compare returned prices while preserving currency and delivery context.

use_cases.title: Research Product Categories
use_cases.description: Use keyword or bestseller discovery with price and rating filters to assemble a bounded product sample.

use_cases.title: Feed Product Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Retrieve repeatable JSON datasets through the runner or API examples for an externally managed reporting workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up One Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a lookup for ASIN [ASIN] on [marketplace]. Confirm Apify charges before running, then summarize returned price, rating, and stock.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Filtered Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Find [keyword] on [marketplace] with minRating 4 and maxPrice [amount]. Limit discovery to 10 items and one page; report missing values.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Selected Markets
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare requests for [ASIN list] across [domains]. Confirm total product requests and charges before execution; compare returned prices without assuming currency equivalence.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Asynchronous Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an asynchronous export for [search URLs] with [limits]. Confirm costs, poll until completion, retrieve the dataset, and report failures without exposing credentials.

best_practices: Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only public product inputs without cookies, session data, or private account details.
Review Apify pricing and site terms; cap discovery pages and items, and separately bound explicit ASINs, URLs, and domain combinations.
Validate a small sample before scaling, record marketplace and delivery settings, and handle missing values or failure rows explicitly.
anti_patterns: Treating maxItems as a total request or spending cap when explicit products and additional domains can increase work.
Assuming prices are guaranteed, currency displays are equivalent, or every optional detail field will appear.
Using the synchronous runner for large exports or assuming the skill provides scheduling, alerts, or private review access.

faq.question: What must I install or configure?
faq.answer: Configure an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN. The bundled runner requires Node.js 18 or later; the shell examples use curl and sometimes jq.

faq.question: Which inputs are supported?
faq.answer: The schema accepts product URLs, ASINs, keyword terms, search URLs, and bestseller URLs, with options for 21 Amazon marketplaces.

faq.question: Does this skill run locally without external services?
faq.answer: No. The local runner submits inputs to an Apify Actor. Apify processes the request and bills usage according to current pricing.

faq.question: Does maxItems cap all work?
faq.answer: No. It caps discovery rows only. Explicit product URLs and ASINs are always processed, and domain combinations can increase work.

faq.question: Can it collect private reviews or account data?
faq.answer: No. The skill targets public data and prohibits cookies or sessions. Full review pagination is login-gated and unsupported.

faq.question: Are scheduling and CSV export built in?
faq.answer: No. The supplied examples retrieve JSON. Scheduling, historical storage, alerts, and CSV conversion require an external workflow.
